Excluded from the snapshot:

  README.md and other repository documentation

The vendored files are a pinned runtime copy. Do not edit them by hand. To
refresh, re-copy the same paths from the upstream commit and update this file.
Keep the skill's original scripts, adapters, references, and tests separate from
vendor/.
